description: Permanently deletes an opportunity from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone.

opportunity_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity to delete.
opportunity_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the opportunity you want to delete. You can copy this from the opportunity's URL or details page.
opportunity_id.title: Opportunity Id

name: delete_opportunity

DeleteOpportunityResponse.description: Response for DELETE Opportunity. HTTP 204 No Content - Successful deletion returns an empty response body. The 204 status code itself confirms the opportunity was successfully deleted.
DeleteOpportunityResponse.title: DeleteOpportunityResponse
